Plot spatial expression across normalisation methods

plot_spatial_expression.Rd

Plot spatial expression of selected genes across multiple normalisation methods.

Usage

plot_spatial_expression(
  norm_list,
  genes,
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  method_order = NULL,
  scale_expr = TRUE,
  point_size = 0.5,
  colour_option = "magma",
  ncol_genes = 1,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

norm_list

Named list of normalised SpatialExperiment objects.

genes

Character vector containing genes to plot.

assay_name

Name of assay containing expression values. Default is `"logcounts"`.

method_order

Optional character vector specifying the order of normalisation methods.

scale_expr

Logical. If TRUE, expression is scaled between 0 and 1 within each gene across all methods.

point_size

Point size for spatial locations.

colour_option

Viridis colour option.

ncol_genes

Number of columns used when combining gene-specific unscaled plots.

theme_name

Plot theme. One of `"classic"`, `"bw"`, `"minimal"`, or `"gray"`.

Value

A list containing the plotting data and plot.

Details

When `scale_expr = TRUE`, expression is scaled from 0 to 1 separately for each gene across all normalisation methods. The resulting maps are displayed using a facet grid with methods in rows and genes in columns.

When `scale_expr = FALSE`, the original expression values from the selected assay are retained. A separate plot is created for each gene, with normalisation methods shown as facets. Therefore, each gene has its own colour scale.
